This black-and-white editorial cover features the red masthead "TEMPO" at the top. Above it, centered text reads "EDISI KHUSUS HARI PAHLAWAN," and below it is "9-15 NOVEMBER 2015." In the upper center, the bold black text "Bung Tomo" is positioned over smaller text "Soerabaja di Tahun 45."

A man in profile, wearing a white shirt and a dark peci cap, dominates the foreground. He is speaking into a metal microphone on a stand, his mouth open and his right arm extended forward with an open palm. In the background, a large, dense crowd of people, many wearing caps, fills an outdoor space. Trees and distant structures are visible on the horizon line behind the crowd. 

In the bottom left corner, there is a price of "RP 39.500," a website address "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and an ISSN barcode. A small, dark glass containing a liquid sits on a ledge in the lower right foreground. The entire image has a grainy texture, characteristic of an older photograph.
